HPINBAR.EnableHint: Displays HP numbers, Temp HP overlays, and the AC shield badge on token health bars in this world.
HPINBAR.VisibleTo: [HP in Bar] Who Sees the Numbers
HPINBAR.VisibleToHint: Who reads the exact HP on a token's bar. Anyone who can see the bar still sees the bar itself.
HPINBAR.VisibleToOwner: The token's owners and the GM
HPINBAR.VisibleToEveryone: Everyone who can see the bar
HPINBAR.FontSizeHint: Base font size for the HP text and AC badge (automatically scales with map resolution).
HPINBAR.StrokeColorHint: Outline color for readability against the bar background.
HPINBAR.StrokeWidthHint: Thickness of the text outline in pixels.
HPINBAR.AcVisibleTo: [HP in Bar] Who Sees the AC Shield
HPINBAR.AcVisibleToHint: Who sees the AC shield badge on a token's health bar.
HPINBAR.TempShieldHint: Draws temporary hit points as a see-through blue shield over the health bar, instead of only dnd5e's thin stripe. The +12 next to the HP numbers shows either way.
HPINBAR.TempText: [HP in Bar] Temp HP in the Numbers
HPINBAR.TempTextHint: How temporary hit points show in the HP text. The blue on the bar shows them either way.
EASYTEMPHP.EnableHint: Makes Temporary HP selectable as a Token Bar attribute, shows regular HP in Bar 1 and Temp HP in Bar 2 in the Token HUD, and keeps standard D&D 5e damage deduction order.
EASYTEMPHP.AutoSetBar2: [Easy Temp HP] Auto-Assign Temp HP to Bar 2
EASYTEMPHP.AutoSetBar2Hint: Automatically uses Temporary HP (attributes.hp.temp) for Bar 2 whenever a token's Bar 2 attribute is empty.
EASYTEMPHP.HudTooltip: Temporary Hit Points (Temp HP). Type a number to set/overwrite, or +5 / -3 to adjust. 0 clears Temp HP.
EASYTEMPHP.Bar1Tooltip: Regular Hit Points (without Temp HP). Type -5 for damage (deducts from Temp HP first), +5 for healing, or a number to set regular HP directly.
SIMPLELIGHT.EnableHint: Adds a button to the Token HUD to quickly configure common D&D light sources.
EASYFLIP.EnableHint: Allows flipping selected tokens horizontally using the keybinding (default: F).
